title.narrative: Línea Aborto Chiapas/Lesbianas feministas por el derecho a la información

description.narrative: Línea Aborto Chiapas/Lesbian feminists for the right to information is a collective of lesbians and feminists who take action in favor of the life and autonomy of women. It was founded in 2015 as a result of the need to accompany migrant women to manage their abortions, in most cases the result of sexual assault. Because of their migratory status, these women did not have access to health systems, the collective began to accompany them.The grant will support the following specific priorities:- provide safe support for abortions in the first and second trimester,- strengthen the action and impact of the collective in the change of public policies- strengthen learning communities for the training of abortion companions in the first and second trimester- improve access to misoprostol and mifepristone for people in precarious situations.
